DONE

I ported the server to Zig 0.16. A clean build passes all 4 cases in `node check.mjs`, all 8 unit tests pass (`zig build test`), and `zig fmt --check` is clean.

I also tested the running server by hand:
- **Large values:** a 1 MiB value with arbitrary bytes comes back byte-for-byte. A body one byte over the limit gets a clean `413`.
- **Concurrency:** 200 parallel PUTs and GETs all succeeded. 100 connections were opened at once, each sending only part of its request, and all were answered
